title: Band stays, parks, truck advertising and moonlight dances
summary: Bands stayed about a week, played the undertaker's parks, advertised from a truck, and played moonlight dances until morning.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: How long would the band stay in Pensacola?
Well they'd keep them some time, about a week, just stay a week.
Would they play at different places while they were there?

Yeah, at the parks. Prince Morris, that's the Undertaker, he had parks built all around you know. There was three brothers in there, all was the Undertakers. But he was the one who used to book all the bands there.
Would they do an advertisement before they played?

Yeah, we'd advertise. We'd put a piano on a truck. We'd go around the truck and advertise. The band was from New Orleans, see? And we'd play the moonlight dances at night. On Sunday nights we'd have to wait and start playing like at twelve o'clock, that'd be Monday morning. Or they didn't lie to play during the Sunday night. And they'd have a big moon right up in the corner, and they'd turn that moon on. And we'd play until five o'clock the next morning.
Do you remember Joe Oliver coming there?
Yeah, I remember Joe Oliver coming there.
